cases.refreshed: Children in grades K-5 will discover the joy of reading while improving their reading skills through practice with Grant on Mondays. Our reading buddy will listen to children and help them build confidence in their ability to read. The reading buddy will ask questions about the books to help children understand what they read. Children will enjoy one-on-one interaction with Grant, who has been trained to create a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers. Reading Buddies are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cases.refreshed: A volunteer tech mentor offers 1-on-1 help with computer skills. Are you a senior trying to catch up with the digital world? Would you like to learn how to create an email, to search the internet, to create and edit Microsoft Word documents, to do online job searching or to complete online job applications? Increase your digital literacy today. Our tech mentors can guide you in learning a variety of computer skills that enable you to better use the library's public computers and to benefit from the library's freely available online resources, including ebooks! Don't worry about not having a computer; iPads will be available for in-library use during the mentoring session. You can drop in for help from the tech mentor. If you have more questions, please call us at 408-808-3053.

cases.refreshed: Preserve your old photographs, home movies, records and cassettes! How to Access: Check the Vintage Media Lab page. If appointments are still available for the month, click the Book@Rinconada button near the top of the page. Otherwise, check back on the first Monday of the month for another chance to sign up. Each appointment includes a skilled volunteer or staff person to assist you. Appointments are limited to a single two-hour appointment per week per person. Because space and time in the Vintage Media Lab are limited, we appreciate your cooperation in regard to equipment, storage and cleanliness. What to Bring: Laptop; SD Card, Memory Card; USB Drive, Flash Drive or Memory Stick; External Hard Drive; Your Vintage Media!
